title: Chipotle removes jalapeños amid US salmonella outbreak investigation
excerpt: Restaurant chain pulls peppers ‘out of an abundance of caution’ as salmonella outbreak sickens 110 people
content_html:
Chipotle said on Tuesday ⁠it had removed jalapeños from some of the chain’s restaurants after identifying ⁠the peppers as ⁠a ​potential ingredient tied to a salmonella outbreak, replacing them ⁠with supplies from different growers.

The company said it ​began tracing ‌ingredients through its supply ‌chain after learning of a ‌potential outbreak and identified jalapeños from a common lot as a possible source.

“Out of an abundance of caution, we proactively removed the jalapeños from ‌our restaurants and replaced them with product from different growers,” ​Chipotle said, adding that it was cooperating with public health authorities investigating the outbreak.

Shares of Chipotle fell 7% in Tuesday-⁠afternoon trading.

Earlier on Tuesday, Bloomberg News ⁠reported the company had removed jalapeños from ​multiple ​stores in Minnesota ​after learning the peppers may be ​linked ‌to a ​salmonella ​outbreak in the state that has sickened 110 people.

That outbreak is separate from one centering on cases of cyclosporiasis – an intestinal illness – that has affected nine states. The cyclosporiasis outbreak had sickened more than 6,700 people nationwide, including two in Michigan who died.

An FDA investigation linked the cyclosporiasis outbreak to iceberg lettuce sourced from privately held Taylor Farms ⁠operations in central Mexico, but authorities are still looking for other potential sources.

content_html_zh:
Chipotle 周二表示，在确定辣椒是与沙门氏菌爆发有关的潜在成分后，该公司已将墨西哥辣椒从该连锁店的一些餐厅中下架，并用不同种植者的供应来代替。

该公司表示，在得知潜在的疫情爆发后，它开始通过供应链追踪成分，并确定来自普通批次的墨西哥辣椒可能是来源。

Chipotle 表示：“出于谨慎考虑，我们主动将墨西哥辣椒从餐厅中撤下，并用不同种植者的产品取而代之。”并补充说，该公司正在与公共卫生部门合作调查疫情。

Chipotle 的股价在周二下午的交易中下跌了 7%。

周二早些时候，彭博新闻社报道称，在得知辣椒可能与该州沙门氏菌爆发有关（该州已导致 110 人患病）后，该公司已从明尼苏达州多家商店下架了墨西哥辣椒。

这次疫情与环孢子虫病（一种肠道疾病）病例不同，后者已影响了九个州。 环孢子虫病的爆发已导致全国 6,700 多人患病，其中密歇根州有两人死亡。

FDA 的一项调查将环孢子虫病的爆发与墨西哥中部私人泰勒农场的卷心生菜联系起来，但当局仍在寻找其他潜在来源。
